subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of A. Only three people sit between G and A. C is an immediate neighbour of F and E. D sits second to the left of F. How many people sit to the left of F?
solution: Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. 1) Only two people sit to the left of A. 2) Only three people sit between G and A. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e06b045dfc31f5dbaeb7317f21abe9dff36d4b569a96379300fa71c48c32aff.png]
